market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $110 in April?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month is around $96 on April 27, 2026 with month low around $94. Hitting $110 in remaining 3 trading days requires roughly 15% surge - possible only with a major escalation in the Hormuz crisis. EIA Q2 forecast peaks Brent at $115, implying WTI at perhaps $110-112 peak but not necessarily in April.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sudden military escalation in Hormuz could spike futures intraday.
